highlights: Keep independent prompts, questions, and notes on a responsive terminal board with keyboard and mouse control.
Resume durable local sessions with search, recovery, and undo across restarts.
Edit exact Unicode text, use the native clipboard, and keep large pastes or local files folded until needed.
Submit thoughts to verified adjacent Herdr agent panes in any direction.
Use the versioned JSON CLI and dedicated Proqi skill for explicit agent and script access.
Coordinate confirmed Homebrew updates across active Proqi sessions on macOS and Linux.
Collect content-redacted local diagnostics even when the main database is locked, malformed, or newer than this Proqi version.
Keep submitted thoughts protected by durable delivery records and duplicate in-flight suppression.
Restore terminal state through bounded shutdown, signals, PTY closure, and child-process failures.
Use searchable overlays and improved Unicode wrapping across a wider range of terminals.
Receive installation-aware update prompts through safer coordinated session ownership.
Install the Proqi binary from crates.io with Rust 1.88 or newer.
Install the checksummed amd64 Debian package on supported Debian and Ubuntu systems.
Keep user sessions and state when removing the Debian package.
Verify startup concurrency, state-path safety, schema coordination, and Linux compatibility through package contracts.
Select several thoughts, then copy, cut, delete, collapse, or submit them as one ordered action.
Duplicate the focused thought or selection with Primary+D.
Scroll overflowing boards one wrapped line at a time with reliable bounds after edits and resizes.
Rename and mutate active sessions through the versioned JSON CLI while their Proqi TUI remains open.
Replace thought content idempotently while preserving persistent editor undo.
Install a local TOML theme or override individual semantic colors in config.toml.
Start from auto, light, or dark and customize the complete semantic palette.
Reject inaccessible custom palettes before entering the terminal and retain the limited-color fallback.
Keep the shortcut reference aligned and scrollable in wide, narrow, and shallow panes.
Run an immediate update check from the command palette while eligible startup checks remain nonblocking.
Submit to a ready adjacent Codex pane before its first prompt establishes a Codex session.
Press Down twice on + New thought to create a durable blank and enter edit mode.
Continue downward past the final thought directly into a new editable thought.
Import shell-escaped Ghostty and Finder file drops as folded file or image attachments.
Preserve ordinary prompt text exactly when an escaped payload does not resolve completely to existing absolute local files.
Start typing or pasting on an empty board, then submit and keep or remove the active content with Primary+Enter shortcuts.
Complete local skills, agents, and commands, and insert inert references to recognized coding agents across the current Herdr server.
Build larger prompts with multi-selection, duplication, reordering, smart-list editing, and atomic whole-board submission.
On macOS, turn new images from a configured directory into private, annotatable thoughts with bounded Screenshot Inbox listening.
Verify file and image attachments immediately before submission so inaccessible sources leave the complete board unchanged.
Submit directly through Herdr to Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Hermes, with documented conditional support for OpenCode and Kilo.
Start with six ordinary practice thoughts on a pristine first interactive board, with highlighted shortcuts and Herdr-aware guidance.
Split or extract a thought with Primary+T, or merge a contiguous Board selection with t, as one restart-safe operation with undo and redo.
Delete every Unicode sentence touched by the cursor or selection with Primary+Shift+U while Primary+U continues to delete one logical line.
Press Space on one selected collapsed placeholder to insert a separator before it without replacing the attachment, reference, or folded paste.
Press Up twice at the first thought to create above it, use arrows or matching Vim-style navigation, and delete in Board mode with d or physical Del.
Continue typing immediately after Screenshot Inbox capture because every inserted image path now ends with one ordinary space.
